intent.raw: A command, a visible button that suggests an IDE ergonomics improvement and self-assembles and tests it; when finished it sends a notification with a test for the user to run and approve.
intent.objective: Define the reusable route for a self-improving IDE Ergonomics action that suggests an evidenced improvement, assembles and tests it in an isolated candidate space, and gates all promotion behind a user-run test and explicit approval.
intent.operator_sentence: First suggest one evidenced ergonomics candidate, then assemble and test it in isolation against a pre-registered criterion, and only promote it after the user runs the delivered test and approves.

route_menu.context_hint: The route separates autonomous suggest/assemble/test from human-gated promotion because the loop can build and test itself but must never ship itself.

items.label: Approval-gated self-assembly
items.description: Suggest, assemble, and test autonomously in an isolated candidate space; promote only after a user-run test and explicit approval.

items.label: Autonomous promotion
items.description: Let the loop promote its own green build with no user test; blocked because assembled-and-green is not shipped.

items.label: Proposal only, no build
items.description: Suggest candidates but stop before assembly; the L0 fallback when build consent is declined or autonomy is not yet earned.

steps.name: Suggest one evidenced ergonomics candidate
stop_conditions: Block if the suggestion cites no map entry and no friction signal.
Flag if the proposed acceptance idea is not falsifiable.

steps.name: Confirm scoped build consent
stop_conditions: Block assembly unless consent is granted and a candidate-space write allowlist is named.
Block if any allowlist path falls outside the candidate space.

steps.name: Assemble invoke and owner-lifecycle drafts in isolation
convergence_criteria: All invoke and owner-lifecycle drafts live inside the consented candidate space.
Owner-lifecycle drafts are marked not promoted.
No canonical or runtime path is touched.
stop_conditions: Block if assembly would write outside the candidate space.
Block if any arcanum/ canonical capability, definition, or runtime path is touched.

steps.name: Freeze the acceptance criterion before any run
stop_conditions: Block the run if no falsifiable success and failure condition is frozen.
Block if the criterion is editable after a result exists.

steps.name: Run the self-test against the frozen criterion
convergence_criteria: The verdict is one of SURVIVED, FALSIFIED, or INVALID against the frozen criterion.
FALSIFIED or INVALID leaves a residue entry and ends the autonomous loop.
Only SURVIVED proceeds to notify the user.
stop_conditions: Block if the run edits the success condition.

steps.name: Notify the user and gate promotion on their test and approval
convergence_criteria: The notification delivers a bounded user-runnable test, not a promotion.
Promotion is authorized only with an approved decision and a passing user test.
Rejected or deferred leaves the candidate in its space with residue.
stop_conditions: Block promotion until the user runs the test and approves.
Block any notification that claims done or shipped.

steps.name: Route promotion through the owning capability with a receipt
convergence_criteria: The owning capability writes the promoted artifact and returns a receipt.
The loop never writes the promoted artifact from its own state.
stop_conditions: Block if promotion runs without an approved user-approval-decision.
Block if the loop attempts to write the promoted artifact directly.

gates.condition: Assembly may begin only after the user grants scoped consent with a candidate-space write allowlist.
All assembly and testing stays inside the consented candidate space; no arcanum/ canonical capability, definition, or runtime path is written.
The acceptance criterion is frozen before the run and cannot be edited after a result exists.
Assembled-and-green is not shipped: nothing is promoted, installed, or claimed shipped until the user runs the delivered test and approves.
Promotion routes through the capability that owns the target lifecycle and returns a receipt; the loop never writes the promoted artifact itself.

boundaries.contract: The loop writes only inside the consented candidate space; canonical and runtime surfaces are read-only to it.
Only an approved user decision with a passing user test authorizes promotion, which the owning capability performs and receipts.

authority.lifecycle: owning capability selected at promotion (spellcraft or sigil-development)
authority.execution: loop assembles and tests; owning capability promotes after approval
authority.validation: experiment-harness against a pre-registered criterion plus the user-run test
authority.evidence: candidate-space drafts, frozen criterion, and self-test result with concrete paths
authority.memory: memory records the candidate or decision only on explicit request
authority.promotion: user approval plus passing user test plus owner receipt

state_namespaces.write_policy: Write freely inside the consented candidate space only.
Read-only to the loop; writes require the owning capability after approval.
Out of scope for the loop; regenerated by the owner after promotion.

promotion_splits.rule: A green self-test supports promotion but does not authorize it; user approval plus a passing user test is required.

promotion_guardrails: Assembled-and-green is not shipped without the user test and approval.
Assembly never writes canonical or runtime surfaces.
The acceptance criterion is frozen before the run and cannot be retrofitted.
Promotion is performed by the owning capability with a receipt, never by the loop.
